newsitem.title: FRANCE: Airbus says Gulf Air delays A330 delivery.
newsitem.headline: Airbus says Gulf Air delays A330 delivery.

text.p: Airbus Industrie said on Wednesday that Gulf Air has opted to take delivery of six A330 passenger jets from 1999 instead of 1998 as originally announced.

"Gulf Air has exercised contract provisions which allow them to take delivery in 1999," said an Airbus spokesman. He confirmed the firm orders were placed in November 1995 with delivery announced for 1998, but the airline has opted for pushing that back to 1999.
Average price for an A330 is $125 million, industry sources said.
Gulf Air, which is owned equally by Qatar, Oman, Abu Dhabi and Bahrain, has been in talks with its shareholders on a financial restructuring to ease its $2 billion debt burden.
The wide-body A330-300 twinjet typically seats 335 passengers.
